svg.title: M15: From declared test cases to a submission another person can verify
svg.desc: Freeze rules and expected outcomes, capture permitted cases and check behavior. Export six coherent authorized artifacts and rehearse selected queries twice. In the illustrative spend case, the test passes by correctly reporting a breached requirement. Release readiness and full-claim satisfaction remain different results.

g.text: M15 / VALIDATION AND SUBMISSION / PROPOSED DESIGN
A correct breach is a passing test.
Prove the behavior, preserve the failure, then package the evidence for somebody else.

g.title: Freeze rules, scope and independently expected outcomes
Execute permitted cases and attacks, preserving actual provenance
Recheck arithmetic, assess held-out model quality and measure full query outcomes
Declared cases produce captured evidence and measured verification outcomes
Six required artifacts are exported at coherent versions for the authorized audience
g.text: One coherent assessment set • required local inputs • authorized audience • exact versions

g.title: Required artifact one: openable evidence for scored runs
Required artifact two: dated owned threshold specifications
Required artifact three: runnable judge-selectable control test tool
Required artifact four: named actual passing and breaching cases
Required artifact five: architecture matching the actual implementation
Required artifact six: scoped known gaps and their effect on claims
g.text: What is missing and why it matters

g.title: Validate the package through timed judge-selected rehearsals
Two rehearsals must produce the selected answer and supporting records within two minutes
g.text: Chosen control + run/window → answer + supporting records within 2 minutes

g.title: Illustrative correct detection: software test passes while actual spend requirement is breached
g.text: Illustrative result: 10,800 tokens against a 10,000 cap
Control requirement: BREACHED · Checker test: PASS if it correctly shows 800 overshoot
Completion and release readiness require the rest of the evidence and gates.
No campaign executed here. Actual completed controls: 0/3. Design review is not implementation proof.
